summary: Arterial kerb with no parked cars and peak-hour no stopping.
reasons: Main road, no kerbside parking seen

drivers.seclusion: Parkland on the north side, but flats 20-27 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts the traffic lane with a grass bank behind; no pull-off.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this kerb; 2P weekdays then no stopping 4-6:30pm.

sun_shade: Tree shade falls from the north-side trees.
